g.title: DIC_QSP_Model
g.text: Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation (DIC) — QSP Mechanistic Map
One consumption process, two independently-set clocks: (1) the sign of the acute-phase term on each protein's synthesis, and (2) the PAI-1 : tPA molar ratio.
Thrombotic (sepsis) and haemorrhagic (APL / obstetric) DIC are not two diseases but the same equations read at two settings of those two clocks.

g.title: F_dep
g.text: Fdep ← a STOCK, not a rate
★ no drug acting on the rate

g.title: X_clock1
g.text: CLOCK 1 — the sign of the acute-phase term
Fibrinogen synthesis is multiplied by (1 + A·IL6/(K+IL6)).
Antithrombin and protein C synthesis are multiplied by 1/(1 + A'·IL6/(K+IL6)).
SEPSIS: A ≈ 3 → the substrate is replenished while the brakes are not.
⇒ unopposed thrombin with NORMAL fibrinogen ⇒ microthrombosis, not bleeding.
APL: A ≈ 0 → nothing replenishes fibrinogen while plasmin eats it.

g.title: X_clock2
g.text: CLOCK 2 — the PAI-1 : tPA molar ratio
Free tPA = max(0, [tPA] − [PAI-1]); binding is 1:1 and effectively irreversible.
SEPSIS: tPA 0.29 nM vs PAI-1 8.9 nM (30:1) ⇒ free tPA ≈ 0 ⇒ fibrinolytic SHUTDOWN
⇒ the deposited stock has no exit ⇒ organ failure.
APL: PAI-1 normal, annexin-A2 cofactor on blasts ⇒ free tPA ≫ 0 ⇒ HYPERFIBRINOLYSIS
tranexamic acid enters ONE equation with ONE sign, and its clinical
benefit changes sign automatically. It is not two rules; it is one term.

g.title: X_product
g.text: WHY THE TRIALS READ THE WAY THEY DO — three products
1. Heparin effect = AT_frac × (1 + Emax·C/(EC50+C)). At AT = 40% the CEILING is 40%
of normal — a dose increase cannot recover it. Heparin resistance is structural.
2. APC generation = k · THR × TM × EPCR × PC. Sepsis multiplies three fractions
(0.6 × 0.3 × 0.5 ≈ 0.09) — hence the pharmacological logic of giving APC itself.
3. But APC acts on the RATE of deposition; organ failure is driven by the STOCK.
A rate-acting drug given after the stock exists cannot reverse it — which is
exactly the PROWESS → PROWESS-SHOCK difference in enrolment timing.
